apps.name: Amberfader
apps.summary: A compact desktop remote for YouTube Music playing in Firefox.
apps.description: Firefox handles playback. Amberfader provides a separate desktop control panel, connected through Native Messaging. It supports Firefox installed as a system package or Flatpak.

apps.name: Copywraith
apps.summary: Searchable clipboard history, with an optional server to sync between devices.
apps.description: A local-first clipboard manager with clients for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android. An optional self-hosted server keeps clipboard history available across devices.

apps.name: Finsical
apps.summary: A retro virtual aquarium for macOS, Linux and Android.
apps.description: A virtual aquarium with a classic Macintosh presentation, available as desktop and Android apps. A browser build is also available from source.

screenshots.alt: Finsical aquarium displayed inside a classic Macintosh

apps.name: GitEnough
apps.summary: A native Mac Git client with a branch graph and optional AI-written commit messages.
apps.description: Clone repositories, stage changes, commit, pull, push, branch and merge. GitEnough includes an IntelliJ-style branch and merge graph. Requires macOS 14 or later.

apps.name: Jetty
apps.summary: A Mac Dock with flexible placement, information tiles, and a command bar.
apps.description: Place Jetty on a screen edge and choose its alignment. Information tiles, a trash tile, a command bar and multi-monitor support extend the usual Dock functions. Requires macOS 13 or later.

screenshots.alt: Jetty Dock with app launchers, weather, system information and a clock

apps.name: Lantenna
apps.summary: Scan your local network for hosts, names, and open ports.
apps.description: A desktop LAN scanner styled after a classic Mac OS utility. It presents discovered devices, host names and open ports in a browsable list.

screenshots.alt: Lantenna listing local network devices with a selected printer's details

apps.name: Obtainintosh
apps.summary: Track installed apps against GitHub and Forgejo releases, and find suitable updates.
apps.description: Add an app's release repository, compare its published version with your installed copy, and download a suitable release asset for your platform.

screenshots.alt: Obtainintosh comparing installed and latest application versions

apps.name: TopDrawer
apps.summary: An edge-tab launcher with a notes editor for macOS.
apps.description: Keep an app launcher and notes in tabs along a screen edge. The Linux port is in progress; this entry lists the macOS app.

screenshots.alt: TopDrawer showing its edge-tab app launcher

apps.name: Vervellum
apps.summary: A research panel that opens with a hotkey and shows its sources.
apps.description: Summon a research panel from the keyboard, look things up, and inspect the sources behind the response.

screenshots.alt: Vervellum research panel showing a question and response

apps.name: Wrapybara
apps.summary: Turn a website address into a signed Mac app in your Applications folder.
apps.description: Enter a website address. Wrapybara writes a signed .app that opens the site, and places it in /Applications.

apps.name: Zap
apps.summary: A configurable replacement for the Mac's Command-Tab app switcher.
apps.description: Switch between apps or individual windows. Exclude apps from the switcher and choose an appearance theme.

screenshots.alt: Zap app switcher displaying running applications
